normalizedInterpretation: Build a public, client-side PDF text-to-voice reader. Users can upload a PDF, extract readable text in the browser, choose a voice and speaking rate, play/pause/resume/stop speech, navigate through extracted text, and see clear loading, empty, error, and progress states. Do not deploy; repository visibility is public.

requirements.description: Complete the user request as stated.
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Concrete implementation evidence is recorded and the outcome matches the user request.
requirements.evidenceRef: Implemented the root Next.js App Router client app with local PDF upload/drop handling, pdfjs-dist browser extraction with configured worker, 25 MB/type validation, malformed and no-text errors, reset/load-another flow, privacy messaging, readable page sections, SpeechSynthesis voice selection/rate/
